The Promulgation and Adoption of the National Book Policy. The
policy and provisions embraced in the National Book Policy, unless otherwise contrary to
law, shall be the policy of the State pertaining to the book publishing industry. Hence,

adopt and implement the policies embodied therein, provided that, with regards to the

particularly the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, the Commission on Higher

Interior and Local Government, the Department of Trade and Industry, the Board of
Investments, the Department of Finance, the Bureau of Customs and private
sector/stakeholders
comprising of, but not limited to: book publishers, printers, book
sellers, and book authors shall abide and comply with this order.

Administrative Liability. Any violation of this Executive Order by any
person, officer or entity mentioned in the next preceding section shall be held
administratively accountable as provided in R.A. No. 8047 and other pertinent laws.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately after its
publication in a newspaper of general circulation or the official gazette.
